Steps:

Steps information on the UI shows two numbers, the first is the number of steps until the star is deactivated, the second is the number of steps until it is lose game. Once the number becomes 0, the next step will result in deactivation star/lose game
The crystal information on the UI shows two numbers, the first shows the current number of collected crystals, the second shows the required number of collected crystals to activate the star

Click on a point to start moving towards it
Attention! Moving is only possible on an unactivated track
Click on a far point to activate multiple points in 1 step
You can use one point multiple times if it has unactivated paths
Use the teleporter to get to the other side
Click on the far point to go through the portal
Attention! Teleport works only if you stand on it
Collect crystals that are found on the level. Later on you can use them as game currency
A point with transparent lanes is activated after all lanes connected to it become active
Activation of the transparent lane takes place after activation of the simple point to which it is connected
Attention! It is not possible to drive on the transparent lanes
If the points are connected by a transparent lanes, the lane is activated when at least one of these points is activated
A point without paths is activated after all points with transparent lanes around it become active
